title: Structure-ligand observation (Phase 2)
description: The raw observation key of OD-12: structure x receptor instance x ligand entity. Pharmacology is kept in layers (OD-11) and is provisional in Phase 2 — no flattened agonist/antagonist field is authoritative, and no prevalence is computed.

site_occurrence.description: How many modelled instances of this entity are present. Instances are not different ligands.

structural_transducer_annotation.description: Structural observation only; never a pathway claim (SD-04).

functional_pathway_evidence.description: Out of Phase 2 scope. Must stay null; may never be inferred from the structural annotation.

provisional_pharmacology_annotations.description: Layered per OD-11: binding mode, efficacy at receptor, pathway-specific activity, allosteric modulation, database annotation, observed structural state, structural transducer and functional pathway evidence are separate fields and are not collapsed.

provenance.description: Provenance for a derived field. A field whose source object was never loaded must say so with source_not_loaded / source_unavailable / source_field_absent; a silent null is a schema violation.
